title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 79
page_text_ocr_zh:
狐狸赶忙跳下房顶撒腿逃走，他一边跑一边还叫着：“好疼，好疼，母鸡家的房子会咬人！”
螃蟹乐得舞起他的两只大螯。
这时，爱看星星的螃蟹发现，母鸡家房顶上的星星是那么漂亮……

X10.
和狮子握手的老鼠
page_text_en:
The fox hurriedly jumped down from the roof and ran away, shouting as he ran: "Ouch, ouch, the hen's house bites people!"
The crab happily waved his two big claws.
At this moment, the star-loving crab noticed that the stars on top of the hen's house were so beautiful...

X10.
A Mouse Who Shakes Hands with a Lion
summary_zh: 狐狸从房顶逃走后，螃蟹高兴地舞动大螯，并发现母鸡家房顶上的星星很漂亮。右侧页面显示下一章节标题“和狮子握手的老鼠”。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 79
page_text_ocr_zh:
一大清早，胖胖鳄鱼就来问他的好朋友们：“我们今天一起玩什么游戏呢？”
“玩捉迷藏吧！捉迷藏最开心了。”小老鼠说。小老鼠最喜欢玩捉迷藏游戏。他个子小，随便往哪儿一躲，
别人就怎么也找不到。
“不玩捉迷藏。”小兔子说，“昨天刚玩过。”
page_text_en:
One bright morning, the chubby crocodile asked his good friends, "What game shall we play today?"
"Let's play hide-and-seek! Hide-and-seek is the most fun," said the little mouse. The little mouse loved playing hide-and-seek. He was small, so he could just hide anywhere,
and no one could find him.
"No hide-and-seek," said the little rabbit. "We just played it yesterday."
summary_zh: 胖胖鳄鱼邀请朋友们玩游戏，小老鼠提议玩捉迷藏，小兔子则表示昨天刚玩过，不想再玩。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 79
page_text_ocr_zh:
胖熊说：“我们来画画吧。我的好朋友狮子是一只非常漂亮、非常棒的狮子，咱们请他当模特。”

“好哇！”小刺猬和胖胖鳄鱼都说，“这是个好主意，画画太有意思了。”

“我害怕。”小老鼠说，“假如狮子发起脾气来，会不会把我们都吃掉？”

“才不会呢，他是一只挺温和的狮子。”胖熊说着就出门去找他的好朋友狮子。

不一会儿，胖胖鳄鱼和他的伙伴们就来到大橡树下，给狮子画像。
page_text_en:
The bear said, "Let's draw! My good friend the lion is a very beautiful and wonderful lion. Let's ask him to be our model."

"Great!" the hedgehog and the fat crocodile said, "That's a great idea. Drawing is so much fun!"

"I'm scared," the little mouse said, "What if the lion gets angry and eats us all?"

"No way! He's a very gentle lion," the bear said, then went out to find his good friend the lion.

Soon, the fat crocodile and his friends arrived under the big oak tree to draw the lion.
summary_zh: 胖熊提议请狮子当模特画画，小刺猬和胖胖鳄鱼赞同，小老鼠担心狮子会吃掉大家，胖熊安慰说狮子很温和，随后大家来到大橡树下准备为狮子画像。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 79
page_text_ocr_zh:
狮子很客气地和大家打个招呼，
就坐在大树下，让大家给他画像。
伙伴们都围着狮子，举起画笔认真地画了起来。
只听见画笔在纸上唰唰地响着……
胖胖鳄鱼检查一下大家画得怎么样，小兔子、小刺猬、胖熊画得都不错。
胖胖鳄鱼在小老鼠身边停下了，
他说：“小老鼠，你这是画的什么呀？”
page_text_en:
The lion politely greeted everyone,
then sat under the big tree, asking them to draw his portrait.
All the friends gathered around the lion, picking up their paintbrushes and drawing carefully.
They could hear the brushes scratching on the paper...
Fat Crocodile checked everyone's drawings. The rabbit, the hedgehog, and the fat bear all drew quite well.
Fat Crocodile stopped beside the little mouse,
and said, "Little mouse, what are you drawing?"
summary_zh: 狮子坐在大树下让大家为他画像，朋友们纷纷认真作画，胖胖鳄鱼检查后，好奇地问小老鼠画的是什么。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 79
page_text_ocr_zh:
大家围过来一看，小老鼠把狮子画成了一只凶巴巴的猫，都笑了起来。
听到大伙儿的笑声，狮子说：“能让我也看看吗？”
胖胖鳄鱼把小老鼠的画递给了狮子。
狮子看着画也张嘴笑了，他说：
“我是猫吗？我有这么凶吗？我可是一只挺温和的狮子。”
“狮子从来不欺负人！”胖熊说。
page_text_en:
Everyone gathered around to look. The little mouse had drawn the lion as a fierce cat, and everyone laughed.
Hearing everyone's laughter, the lion said, "Can I see it too?"
The big fat crocodile handed the mouse's drawing to the lion.
The lion looked at the drawing and smiled. He said:
"Am I a cat? Am I really that fierce? I'm actually a very gentle lion."
"Lions never bully anyone!" said the fat bear.
summary_zh: 小老鼠画的狮子被大家看到后，狮子自己也笑了，并表示自己其实很温和，胖熊也附和说狮子从不欺负人。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 79
page_text_ocr_zh:
“连老鼠也不欺负吗？”小老鼠大胆地问。
“我从来不敢欺负老鼠。我有很多老鼠朋友。”狮子还是温和地笑着。
小老鼠不好意思地说：“我要重画一张。”
大家的画都画完了。狮子一张张地看着。
他指着小老鼠的画说：“我最喜欢这张，小老鼠把我画得又威武又温和。
这张画能送给我吗？我想把它挂在我家墙上呢。”
page_text_en:
"Don't you even bully mice?" the little mouse asked boldly.
"I've never bullied a mouse. I have many mouse friends," the lion said, still smiling gently.
The little mouse said不好意思, "I need to draw another one."
Everyone had finished their drawings. The lion looked at them one by one.
He pointed at the little mouse's drawing and said, "I like this one the most. You drew me both brave and gentle.
Can I have this painting? I'd like to hang it on my wall at home."
summary_zh: 小老鼠画了一幅狮子的画像，狮子看到后表示很喜欢，并请求将画送给他挂在墙上，小老鼠则因画得不够好而感到不好意思，想重画一张。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 79
page_text_ocr_zh:
“当然可以。”小老鼠高兴地说，
“我以后还要画一张更好的。”

“谢谢你，小老鼠！”狮子伸出他的
大手和小老鼠的小手使劲握了握。
